test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Given below are six sentences taken from a paragraph. The first and the last sentences are numbered S1 and S2 and are placed in the first and last positions respectively. The other four sentences between the first and last sentences are jumbled up and are numbered A, B, C, and D. Rearrange the jumbled sentences in a logical sequence keeping the unity and coherence of the paragraph intact. Choose the correct alternative that best describes the sequence.

S1. So why develop your financial genius?
A. I can tell you why I have been developing this area of my intelligence.
B. Not because I need to, but because I want to.
C. Only you can answer that.
D. I do it because I want to make money fast.
S2. It is a fascinating learning process.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

• The question asks for the logical arrangement of sentences in a paragraph to maintain unity and coherence.
 
• **Sentence S1** is the opening sentence that introduces the topic: ""So why develop your financial genius?""
